OWNER_NUMBER.description: Owner WhatsApp number with country code, digits only

SESSION_ID.description: Optional complete BRITECH3 WhatsApp session ID; leave blank to use the Get Session ID pairing dashboard

PAIRING_TIMEOUT_MS.description: Maximum pairing attempt duration in milliseconds

PAIRING_DASHBOARD_TOKEN.description: Optional private Bearer token for the Get Session ID dashboard; leave blank only for intentional public mode
